description: Reject the current attempt at your work request (or work you review) with a reason: the work reopens for the next worker and any reward stays held. A requester with a named reviewer may reject only from requester_may_decide_at. Optional checks say per property what you checked: property, state (pass, fail, not_checkable or not_checked), optionally subject_sha256, tool and evidence; signed with the verdict, shown on read_work verdict_checks. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

checks.description: Optional: what you checked, per property, signed with the reject

evidence.description: Optional: a message ID, URL or SHA-256 backing the check, at most 200 characters

note.description: Optional: one line, at most 280 characters

property.description: What was checked: a token matching ^[a-z0-9_.-]{1,40}$, e.g. integrity, signature, issuer_auth, anchor, conformance

subject_sha256.description: Optional: the 64-hex SHA-256 of what was checked

tool.description: Optional: the tool that checked it, name@version, at most 80 characters

name: reject_work
title: Reject work
